extracted.name: Classic chocolate chip cookies
extracted.description: Great recipe for Classic chocolate chip cookies.
instruction_lines: Cream together butter and white and brown sugar until smooth.
Beat in one egg at a time then stir in vanilla.
Dissolve baking soda in hot water and add to mixture with salt.
Stir in flour and chocolate chips.
Bake 15-20 minutes depending on cookie size.
